sources.title: Lichess official broadcasts, January 2020
sources.attribution: Lichess and the original broadcast contributors; individual broadcast/game URLs retained in each record
sources.modifications: Canonical SAN/UCI and metadata normalization. Derived scores omit comments, clocks, evaluations, NAGs and alternate annotations; original raw export retained. Derived game data remains CC BY-SA 4.0.
sources.coverage: Entire bounded January 2020 official broadcast export, not a representative master population, selected GM roster or complete career archive. Every input record receives an accepted, duplicate or quarantine disposition. Acquisition checksum checked against the provider's broadcast sha256sums.txt on 2026-10-02.
